title: Everpresent Lambda: match background noise to a consistent observable prescription
faithful_claim: The volume-noise ansatz produces order-of-density stochastic backgrounds, but the published fits test specific finite-seed and perturbation prescriptions; neither establishes a complete causal-set cosmology.

equations.expression: Delta Lambda ~ 1/sqrt(V); rho_Lambda ~ V^(-1/2) ~ H^2 ~ rho_critical

equations.definitions: Lambda is the vacuum density in the source gravitational units; separately conserved ordinary matter/radiation.
